## Checklist
See [AGENTS.md](../AGENTS.md) for the full definition of done.

- [ ] `mise run lint` passes
- [ ] `mise run test` passes, and new logic has a test
- [ ] README (and `docs/`) updated for anything a user can see or do
- [ ] Demo shows the change, and `TestDemoShowsEveryFeature` covers it
- [ ] Screenshots regenerated with `mise run screenshots` if the screen changed (or say why not)
- [ ] Follows the design principles in AGENTS.md (read-only, GitHub-only network, graceful degradation, keys in the action table)
